corrections: 【年份/引用口径 (a)】修正前:"Ferguson et al. 2021 Professional Psychology" → 修正后:线上首发 © 2021,但正式刊出为 2022,Professional Psychology: Research and Practice, 53(2), 205–214, doi 10.1037/pro0000426。铁证:Ferguson 本人在 2024 那篇的参考文献里就写 "Ferguson, C. J., Kaye, L. K., ... (2022). Like this meta-analysis: Screen media and mental health. Professional Psychology: Research and Practice, 53(2), 205–214." 建议写成 "Ferguson et al. 2022(2021 线上首发)"。文章标题为《Like This Meta-Analysis: Screen Media and Mental Health》。

【k 的构念 (a)】修正前:"k=37" 易读成 37 项研究 → 修正后:37 个效应量、来自 33 项独立研究。摘要逐字:"The current meta-analysis included 37 effect sizes from 33 separate studies." 注意 Table 1 表注自己写的是 "k = number of studies",与摘要矛盾,是原文内部口径不一致;引用时应写 "37 个效应量/33 项研究"。

【效应量单位 (a)】修正前:"r+=.052" 被当作相关系数 → 修正后:该 r+ 主体是合并后的标准化回归系数(β,已控制第三变量),非零阶相关。原文:"Effect sizes were operationalized using the metric of r. Particularly for correlational and longitudinal studies, analyses used results which were based upon multivariate analyses resulting in standardized regression coefficients (betas)." 同文的调节分析也直接用 β 报告(无控制 β=.064 vs 有控制 β=.038)。这点重要:拿一个已控制的偏效应去对照 r=.10 的"crud factor"阈值,与拿裸相关对照不是一回事。

【年份/引用口径 (b)】修正前:"Ferguson/Kaye/Branley-Bell/Markey 2024" → 修正后:Accepted May 23, 2024,正式刊出为 2025,Professional Psychology: Research and Practice, 56(1), 73–83, doi 10.1037/pro0000589。建议写 "2025(2024 接收/线上首发)"。

【标题完整性 (b)】修正前:引到 "...Adolescent Mental Health Problems" 为止 → 修正后:完整标题含副标题 "There Is No Evidence That Time Spent on Social Media Is Correlated With Adolescent Mental Health Problems: Findings From a Meta-Analysis"(校样作 "Meta-analysis",正式版作 "Meta-Analysis")。所引前半段逐字无误。

【性别行不是全样本切分 (b)】修正前:"女 .075 / 男 .044" 易读成把 79 个效应分成两半 → 修正后:Male k=27、Female k=29,合计 56,远少于 79;性别行是子集而非对 79 的划分。原文:"allowing for different effects for boys and girls in some studies",即只有部分研究报了分性别效应。原文本身把它称作 "biological sex differences",不是社会性别。

【效应量单位 (b)】修正前:"β=.061" 未加限定 → 修正后:该 β 是"每篇研究中最受控/最保守的那个效应量",原文脚注 3 逐字:"'r' is used here to denote the most controlled/conservative effect size from each study, which in most cases (but not all) were standardized regression coefficients." 即标题说 "Correlated",合并量却是控制后的保守估计——系统性偏向压低,是该文结论方向上的已知口径倾斜。

【效应量非独立 (b)】修正前:"46 研究 79 效应" 未提依赖性 → 修正后:79 个效应来自 46 项研究(同研究多效应:分性别、同一数据集多篇),且原文承认偏离预注册:"This differs from the intent in our preregistration where we had hoped to extract a single effect size from each data set... we decided to include all articles but include potential multiuse data sets as a moderator." 合并 79 个非独立效应会低估标准误,也是 I²=98.8 极端异质的部分来源。
evidence_notes: (a) 独立第二副本交叉验证:https://www.christopherjferguson.com/Like%20This%20Meta.pdf(作者主页,394KB,与 gwern 副本不同文件)提取出完全相同的三行 Table 1 数值,排除单一 PDF 提取错误。

(a) r=.10 阈值逐字:"Although any cutoff threshold is arbitrary, the present analyses determined the cutoff as r = .10. This mitigated against the issue that any values below this would be explained primarily as due to study artifacts rather than real population-level effects (Ferguson & Heene, in press; Przybylski & Weinstein, 2019)." 结果段另有:"...in no case passed the r = .10 threshold for interpretation as hypothesis supportive." → 阈值 r=.10 成立。

(a) 非实验逐字确认:"As a note, the preregistration had criteria for both correlational/longitudinal as well as experimental study best practices. However, ultimately, no experimental studies were included in the analysis." → "相关性 meta 非实验" 成立(检索时纳入标准本含实验,但无一入选)。

(b) 样本构成逐字:"Our search ultimately netted 55 studies on social media use and youth mental health. However, nine were subsequently found to be missing important data... This resulted in a final pool of 46 studies. Between them, allowing for different effects for boys and girls in some studies, these articles included 79 total effect sizes." → "46 研究 79 效应" 成立(55 检出 − 9 缺数据 = 46)。
(b) 非实验逐字确认(脚注 6):"There was only one experimental study; thus, this was not included in the analysis." → 合并估计纯由相关/纵向研究构成,"相关性 meta 非实验" 成立。

(b) 阈值口径:"Consistent with the recommendations of Orben and Przybylski (2019), we considered an effect size of r = .10 as the minimum for practical significance." 与 (a) 的 r=.10 判据一致(两篇同源,皆援引 Ferguson & Heene 的 crud factor 论证)。
(b) 未被论断提及但对引用者关键的一条:Table 1 中 "National survey 53 .067 [.050, .084] ... 99.2 .058 Yes" —— 占 79 个效应中 53 个的国家级调查子组,发表偏倚判定为 Yes(全样本行为 No)。引用"无发表偏倚"时需限定。

(b) 两篇纵向 vs 相关的方向相反:2021/2022 篇纵向(.055)略高于相关(.051),原文称 "Longitudinal studies did not provide any more evidence for effects than correlational studies";2024/2025 篇则相反 —— "The effect sizes for longitudinal studies were slightly smaller (β = .044) than that of correlational studies (β = .072)"。若跨两篇论证"纵向≈相关",需注意这是两个不同方向的对比。

反证检索(对抗性尽责):Rausch & Haidt 的高曝光批评文《Why Ferguson's Meta-Analysis Should Not Be Used to Inform Debates on Social Media's Impact on Depression and Anxiety》(SSRN 5224958)以及 afterbabel 的 "Fundamental Flaws" 三部曲,攻击的是 Ferguson 另一篇 **实验类** meta —— 《Do Social Media Experiments Prove a Link with Mental Health? A Methodological and Meta-Analytic Review》(Psychology of Popular Media),指控项为 Lepp 2022 / Brailovskaia 2022 效应量编码错、Przybylski 2021 等样本量错、违反自定纳入标准。**该批评不针对本论断组的两篇相关性 meta**,故不构成对本组数值的推翻;但也说明引用时必须严格区分 Ferguson 的相关性 meta 与实验 meta,不可混用其批评或其辩护。
未检索到针对这两篇相关性 meta 的已发表更正(correction)或撤稿(erratum)通知。

(b) 预注册与数据可查:OSF 预注册 https://osf.io/9kd4x,数据 https://osf.io/gjt84,PRISMA https://osf.io/yaedq,纳入研究清单 https://osf.io/kx486;原文同时自陈两处偏离预注册(年龄范围放宽保留 n=5 项;每数据集单一效应量改为全纳入+多用数据集作调节变量),以及计算软件由 CMA 改为 jamovi。

corrections: (a) 出版年与卷期:『Ferguson et al. 2021 Professional Psychology』→ 定稿版为 2022 年,Professional Psychology: Research and Practice, 53(2), 205–214,DOI 10.1037/pro0000426;online-first 2021-10-25、纸本 2022-04-01。写 2021 只是 online-first 年份,引用应标 2022(或注明 online first 2021)。

(a) k=37 的构念:表 1 脚注写『k = number of studies』,但摘要逐字为『The current meta-analysis included 37 effect sizes from 33 separate studies』。→ 应表述为『37 个效应量、来自 33 项独立研究』,不能读作『37 项研究』。论文自身此处口径不一致(正文第 524 行又写『37 papers』)。

(a) 样本年龄段不限于青少年:『teens』→ 实际含年轻成人。原文逐字:『The original preregistered study design plan was limited to teen samples, but ultimately this broadened out to include all samples to get a wider view of data among young adults as well. Age is considered as a moderator.』用它支撑纯青少年论断需加限定。

(a) 效应量单位:r+=.052 并非汇总的双变量相关,而是主要由多元回归的标准化系数(beta)转成 r 度量汇总。原文逐字:『Particularly for correlational and longitudinal studies, analyses used results which were based upon multivariate analyses resulting in standardized regression coefficients (betas).』→ 这是『控制协变量后的偏效应』,系统性低于双变量 r 的 meta,跨 meta 比较时不能与双变量 r 直接并列。
(a) 主体是『screen media / screen time』而非社交媒体:全样本 k=37 中,General screens 子组 k=20(r+=.059 [.036,.083]),Social media/internet 子组仅 k=6(r+=.043 [.004,.082])。→ 用 (a) 谈社交媒体时,实际支撑仅 6 个效应量。
(b) 出版年与卷期:『2024 Professional Psychology』→ 定稿版为 2025 年,Professional Psychology: Research and Practice, 56(1), 73–83,DOI 10.1037/pro0000589;early online 2024-10-03、纸本 2025-02-01。

(b) 标题不完整:所引『There Is No Evidence That Time Spent on Social Media Is Correlated With Adolescent Mental Health Problems』逐字无误,但为主标题;完整标题含副标题『: Findings From a Meta-Analysis』(定稿版 Meta-Analysis 大写 A;所引 proof 版作 Meta-analysis)。

(b) 性别差异不成立:所引『女 .075 / 男 .044』两组点估计与 CI 逐字属实,但论文自述该性别调节效应不显著。原文逐字:『Initial results using a mixed-effects model (k = 56) were nonsignificant (p = .074); however, resilience testing suggested that model estimator had an impact on p value with p values ranging from <.001 (Hunter-Schmidt method) to .111 (Sidik-Jonkman method).』→ 不可表述为『女生受影响更大』,只能说两个子组点估计有微小差、且差异未达显著、且两者均低于 .10 判据阈值。
(b) 来源版本:所引 christopherjferguson.com 的 PDF 是未校 BluPencil 校样(页脚『PRO-2023-0960_blupencil ▪ 18 July 2024』,单位名误作『Stenson University』),非 version of record。数字应以 56(1):73–83 定稿版为准。
(b) 阈值单位错配:判据阈值原文以 r 表述(『an effect size of r = .10 as the minimum for practical significance』),而汇总量以 β 报告(β=.061)。论文直接拿 β 与 r 阈值比较,是其自身的单位混用,转述时不宜说成『r+=.061』。
evidence_notes: (a) 一手 PDF 已取回并文本化(gwern 镜像即所引 URL,https://gwern.net/doc/psychiatry/depression/2021-ferguson-2.pdf)。Table 1 逐字:『All studies 37 .052 (.036, .068) χ²(36) = 310.72, p < .001 88.4 .040 No』;『Correlational 25 .051 (.031, .071) … 91.6』;『Longitudinal 12 .055 (.032, .077) χ²(11) = 21.88, p = .025 49.7』。→ k=37、r+=.052 [.036,.068]、I²=88.4、longitudinal .055 vs correlational .051 全部逐字命中。25+12=37 自洽。

(a) r=.10 阈值逐字:『Although any cutoff threshold is arbitrary, the present analyses determined the cutoff as r = .10. This mitigated against the issue that any values below this would be explained primarily as due to study artifacts rather than real population-level effects.』结果段亦逐字:『in no case passed the r = .10 threshold for interpretation as hypothesis supportive』。→ 阈值论断成立。

(a) 非实验逐字确认两处:『All studies included in the final sample were either cross-sectional or longitudinal in nature.』与『the preregistration had criteria for both correlational/longitudinal as well as experimental study best practices. However, ultimately, no experimental studies were included in the analysis.』→『相关性 meta 非实验』成立。

(a) 检索范围逐字:PsycINFO + MedLine,检索词含 ("Screen time" OR "Screen use" … OR "Tablet") AND ("depression" OR "anxiety" OR "loneliness" OR "suicide") AND ("youth" OR "teen*" OR "adoles*");限 2015–2019;排除未发表研究(→ 存在只纳入已发表文献的选择性风险,尽管论文用 Tandem Procedure 判定无发表偏倚)。

(b) 一手 PDF 已取回并文本化(即所引 URL)。Table 1『Meta-analytic Results of Social Media and Mental Health Outcomes』逐字:All studies k=79, β=.061, 95% CI [.047, .075], χ²(78)=4404.45, p<.001, I²=98.8, τ=.055, Publication bias? No;Male k=27, β=.044, [.025, .062], I²=94.7;Female k=29, β=.075, [.050, .101], I²=97.9。→ 79 效应、β=.061 [.047,.075]、I²=98.8、女 .075 [.050,.101]、男 .044 [.025,.062] 全部逐字命中。

(b) 研究数逐字:『in a final pool of 46 studies. Between them, allowing for different … 79 total effect sizes.』摘要亦逐字『a meta-analysis of 46 studies of youth social media use and mental health』。→『46 研究 79 效应』成立。
(b) 非实验逐字确认(脚注 6):『There was only one experimental study; thus, this was not included in the analysis.』→『相关性 meta 非实验』成立。
(b) 阈值逐字:『an effect size of r = .10 as the minimum for practical significance』『effects below this threshold are unable to be distinguished from [noise]』。两篇采用同一 r=.10 判据,阈值来源自洽。
(b) 表内小瑕疵(校样版):Correlational k=48 + Longitudinal k=30 = 78,与 All studies k=79 差 1;Bespoke 行 k=21 但同行齐性检验 df=12(χ²(12)),隐含 k=13,与 21 矛盾(其余各行 df=k−1 均自洽)。属论文/校样层面的不一致,不影响所验四项主数字。
(b) 方向性反差(不在论断内但相关):2024/25 篇中 longitudinal β=.044 [.023,.066] 小于 correlational β=.072 [.05,.090],与 2021/22 篇 longitudinal .055 > correlational .051 的次序相反。若有人拿『纵向不低于横断』当稳健性证据,两篇不一致。

反证检索:未发现任何一篇针对这两项『相关性』meta 的勘误、更正或撤稿。检索到的高声量批评(Rausch & Haidt, SSRN 5224958『Why Ferguson's Meta-Analysis Should Not Be Used to Inform Debates on Social Media's Impact on Depression and Anxiety』;After Babel『Fundamental Flaws of The Only Meta-Analysis of Social Media Reduction Experiments』系列)针对的是 Ferguson 另一篇关于社交媒体『减量/戒断实验』的 meta,不是此处两篇相关性 meta。→ 该批评不构成对本论断组的推翻,但也不能被拿来当作这两篇已被质疑的证据。

利益相关性核查:两篇均未见 COI/资助声明((a) 仅有 Disclosures 段落,内容为预注册 https://osf.io/rehys 与数据 https://osf.io/mex4s/;(b) 校样版无 COI 段)。(a) 致谢中出现德国经费编号 grant no 1706dgn006(对应合著者 Elson 所在机构)。Ferguson 长期公开持『道德恐慌』立场并作为媒体效应专家参与相关公共辩论/诉讼语境,属方向性立场相关;未检索到直接的产业资助或财务 COI 证据。

corrections: (a) 引用年份:'Ferguson et al. 2021' → 正式出版为 2022。Crossref 10.1037/pro0000426 published-online [[2022,4]], 卷期页 53(2), 205–214。PDF 版权行为 ©2021、Accepted July 25 2021(online-first),但 Ferguson 本人在 2024 那篇的参考文献里也自引为 '(2022) ... 53(2), 205–214'。写 2021 只在'预印/在线优先年'意义上成立。

(a) k=37 的单位:不是 37 项研究,而是 37 个效应量来自 33 项独立研究。摘要逐字:'The current meta-analysis included 37 effect sizes from 33 separate studies.' 注意论文自身口径不一致——Table 1 表注写 'k = number of studies',Method 又写 'resulted in 37 papers';但 Table 1 技术类型分组 general screens 20 + smartphones 11 + social media/internet 6 = 37,证明 k 是效应量层级。分母应写 33 studies / 37 effect sizes。

(a) 构念范围:是'屏幕媒体(screen media)'总体 meta,不是青少年专属、也不是社媒专属。逐字:'The original preregistered study design plan was limited to teen samples, but ultimately this broadened out to include all samples to get a wider view of data among young adults as well.' 其中社媒/互联网子组仅 k=6, r+=.043 [.004,.082]。若拿它支撑'青少年 × 社媒'论断,分母只有 6 个效应量。

(b) 标题非逐字:待验论断把标题截断在 'Adolescent Mental Health Problems'。完整正式标题为 'There Is No Evidence That Time Spent on Social Media Is Correlated With Adolescent Mental Health Problems: Findings From a Meta-Analysis'(冒号后的副标题不可略,尤其因为它正是'这是相关性 meta'的自限定语)。

(b) 引用年份/卷页:'2024' 仅为 online-first。Crossref 10.1037/pro0000589 published-online [[2025,2]],正式为 Professional Psychology: Research and Practice, 56(1), 73–83;稿件流程为 Received Sept 22 2023 / Revision May 13 2024 / Accepted May 23 2024。
(b) '46 研究 79 效应'成立但需注意 Table 1 的 k 列同样被表注误标为 'number of studies':Table 1 中 k=79 是效应量数,k=27(男)/29(女)/48(相关)/30(纵向)亦为效应量数,非研究数。

'两篇都是相关性 meta 非实验':(a) 完全成立,逐字 'All studies included in the final sample were either cross-sectional or longitudinal in nature.';(b) 不是 100%,是 78/79。脚注 6 逐字:'There was only one experimental study; thus, this was not included in the analysis.' 该实验效应量仍在总体池(48+30=78,总 79),只是被排除出 study-type 调节分析。应表述为'(b) 79 个效应量中 78 个为相关/纵向,仅 1 个实验'。

(b) 性别差异被漏掉关键限定:女 .075 vs 男 .044 的差异在统计上并不显著。逐字:'Initial results using a mixed-effects model (k = 56) were nonsignificant (p = .074)',且 'both effects fell below the threshold for evidence.' 只并列两个数值会读成'女孩确有更大效应'的既定调节效应,原文并不支持。

(b) 发表偏倚不是干净的'无':Table 1 'All studies' 行虽标 No,但正文逐字 'Evidence from Egger's regression (p = .021) and trim and fill (missing studies: four) suggested potential for publication bias in this meta-analytic data set.',且 National survey 数据集子组 Table 1 直接标 'Yes'。

r=.10 阈值不是 (a) 独有,(b) 用的是同一阈值。(a) 逐字:'Although any cutoff threshold is arbitrary, the present analyses determined the cutoff as r = .10.';(b) 逐字:'we considered an effect size of r = .10 as the minimum for practical significance.' 论断把阈值只挂在 (a) 名下会低估两篇共用同一个(作者自定、自承 'arbitrary' 的)判据。
两篇不是相互独立的验证:(b) 的 4 位作者全部在 (a) 的 14 人作者名单内,同一期刊,且样本有重叠——(b) 正文逐字 'There was an overlap of seven studies (15%) with a previous study of screen time more broadly.' 不宜作为'两项独立 meta 相互印证'呈现。

现存最有力的公开反驳(Rausch & Haidt, SSRN 5224958, 2025;afterbabel 三篇 'Fundamental Flaws')针对的是 Ferguson 另一篇关于 27 项社媒减少 RCT 的**实验性** meta,不是本组这两篇相关性 meta。其核心指控('blends together methods, durations, and outcomes'、样本量提取错误如 600 入组/297 入分析)不能直接搬来推翻本组论断——这反而印证了论断末尾'两篇都是相关性 meta 非实验'这一区分是必要的。
